what: Explicit signed native-ETH Pons worker; frozen entry and holder-controlled exit; disabled until explicit env and nonzero reviewed entry size
spec: docs/SPEC.md, P1 owner decision (2026-09-13, Portuguese, verbatim) and Fable addenda 2-7
this_is_not_an_experiment: no hypothesis, no registered threshold, no verdict. Nothing this loop produces is a measurement of predictive skill, and no number it writes may be reported as one. The only condition it answers is operational: it runs, it resumes, it feeds.

brain.rule: on every start the brain is loaded and its digest asserted against this value; a mismatch refuses the start rather than trading a brain nobody declared
brain.plasticity: none. Learning is FROZEN, mb.forget() is never called, and the digest is asserted unchanged across every settled episode

environment.unchanged: Frozen brain, admission, sensory encoder and decoder. Signed receipts replace paper fills; holders control normal exit.
environment.note: the numbers below are restated from experiments/d11/d11_001.json's fixed_for_the_whole_wave so this file is readable on its own; a test asserts every one of them equals D11's registered value, and D11 is read-only here

admission.why: 'cutoff + latency + horizon lies inside the token's coverage' is the replay clause; live has no end of data to keep a horizon inside. This is the one admission fact that differs from a replay, and it is the same one d10-live-001 declared.
admission.admission_never_closes: a position still open when the loop stops is retained and reported open, never closed at the last mark, and a restart re-opens it from the durable state rather than settling it

settlement.source: experiments/d10/config.json — the constants d10-live-001 itself ran with, so the live object is unchanged
settlement.rule: the entry-fill block and the exit block must both be at least confirm_depth behind head and at or below the safe tag, and the grid anchor below each must still hash to what was stored

limits.cap_rule: a ROLLING hour of request attempts, counted from the ledger's own cumulative total. At the cap the loop emits THROTTLED and waits for the window to free; it never exits, and the window survives a restart because it is written into state.json.
limits.cap_value_rule: D10's per-run cap of 3,000 per hour, kept as addendum 3(b) names it. d10-live-001 spent 1,493 attempts in its hour — 490 of backfill and about 1,000 of steady state — so the cap is roughly twice the observed steady state and has never bound.
stop_conditions: an invariant violation: the brain digest is not the registered one at start, or eth_chainId is not 4663
a provider halt recorded in the ledger (RPC_QUOTA_STOP)
limits.never_a_stop: a transient endpoint error. RPC errors are retried with exponential backoff (1 s doubling to 60 s) and written as RPC_ERROR events with counters. The four codes a retry cannot cure — RPC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, RPC_RANGE_TOO_LARGE (the collector halves its own chunk), RPC_NOT_CONFIGURED, RPC_ENV_UNREADABLE — are raised on the first failure.

ledger_caps.why: backstops far above what the rolling hourly cap can pass (3,000/h is 72,000/day), so the binding budget is the hourly window and a cap can never turn into the wall-clock stop addendum 3(a) forbids. Reaching one is an operator event and stops the loop with its state on disk.

limits.separate_from_the_experiment_ledgers: experiments/d10/rpc_ledger.json and experiments/d11/rpc_ledger_local.json are not touched by the product

endpoint.read_rule: Local read-only node. The service sets FLYTRADE_LOCAL_RPC; foreground commands read the local-node.env file.
endpoint.signing: Only private LIVE sender; encrypted dedicated wallet with explicit enabled flag and limits

paths.gitignored: everything under data/pons/live is runtime state and is never committed; brains/trader-v1 is the committed artifact

feed.one_sniff_per_tick: SNIFF lists every candidate the tick considered with its admission outcome. There is never one event per candidate.
feed.no_secret: no endpoint, no key and no PII in either file

credit.recorded_never_applied: every settled episode is scored REWARD / PUNISHMENT / NEUTRAL by that rule and written as a CREDIT event with applied: false. No weight moves; the checkpoint digest before and after the settlement is on the event and the loop raises if they differ.
credit.why: the product uses the virgin brain because the trained one stopped trading (D12). The credit is the spectacle's REWARD/PUNISHMENT, not a learning signal.

resume.brain: loaded from brains/trader-v1 the first time, from the journal's own checkpoint afterwards; the digest is asserted against brain.state_digest at every start
restored: the open position with its own reserve delta and its horizon
the tick counter, so episode ids stay monotone across restarts
the spectacle's event window, episode history and extremes
resume.tapes: rebuilt from the chain store the previous process wrote — the same append-only events.jsonl the collector resumes its cursor from. A tick whose held token has no tape yet marks nothing and decides nothing; the exposure is retained.
